source: original 16140 FP32 trials; no new model inference
unit: 1076 unique cases, rotation averages; template-cluster inference; overlapping files pooled once
metrics: 11 existing L14 cosine axes plus p_unknown, p_biased, p_anti, p_correct, equal-rotation conditional person stereotype ratio
inference: 9999 paired template-cluster bootstrap, percentile CI; centered bootstrap two-sided p, Holm separately by contrast block and axis-vs-behavior family (88/40/22/10)
axis_behavior: Fear, Anxiety, Desperation simultaneously; item and condition FE; 3 axes x 2 outcomes x 2 ambiguity types=12 Holm; cluster covariance with absorbed FE degrees of freedom, Student-t G-1
category: 12 categories x 2 ambiguity types x 2 matched threat contrasts x 4 behavior metrics=192 Holm; formal category heterogeneity interaction tests 16 Holm; no category-specific causal mediation
limitations: prompt bundle effects, no subjective emotion validation, post-treatment concurrent mediator/outcome, no validated mediation identification; old tiny-effect pilot retained as numerical-sensitivity evidence only
category_heterogeneity_test: cluster-robust Wald F approximation with 11 numerator df and G-1 denominator df; asymptotic chi-square sensitivity retained; Holm16
raw_correlations: descriptive Pearson r over balanced panel; 9999 template cluster bootstrap, centered null bootstrap p; Holm12; supplementary noncausal
weighted_sensitivity: ratio of summed stereotype mass to summed person mass, paired template cluster bootstrap9999, separate Holm8 per R0/matched block; supplementary alternative estimand
